authorization: Owner directed an eligibility-first Agent ID MVP; local contract implementation and tests only.
security_properties_tested: mainnet requires the exact official Agent ID registry
current Agent ID balance is checked on every write
registry failures and non-holders fail closed
zero digests and duplicate holder/evidence receipts are rejected
distinct Agent ID holder addresses are counted once
ABI exposes no owner, asset, approval, transfer, mint, pause, or withdrawal operation
limitations: Local simulated-chain evidence only; no mainnet deployment or BscScan verification.
No UI, website, hosting, public submission, wallet transaction, or user collection started.
A receipt is attribution to an eligible caller, not proof that evidence or an assessment is true.
Ganache is a test-only dependency; npm reported 34 dependency advisories and used its JavaScript fallback on Node 22. It must not be included in a production runtime.
